integrity.candidate_to_durable_transition: WRITING -> SEALED only after matching worker attempt/lease epoch, manifest facts and immutable part ledger
integrity.post_seal_integrity_downgrade: SEALED -> CORRUPT or MISSING retains the original sealed facts
integrity.cursor: opaque HMAC-signed and bound to artifact, relation/table and canonical projection
integrity.parts: table-scoped canonical paths and contiguous ordinals; stream SHA-256 is checked before read
integrity.retention: active lease, child run, exposure, release candidate, selection and verification references pin storage

server_boundary: No manifest contains an absolute filesystem path, database locator, credential, market row or Execution/Trading System authority.
No P05 client/browser route, raw artifact path, cursor signing secret, worker lease or database credential is exposed.
Exact decimal values cross P05 boundaries as strings; UTC values are explicit and opaque IDs are never parsed by consumers.
The regenerated Atlas type only reflects a pre-existing P04 read-only OpenAPI route; it neither creates a P05 browser route nor grants run submission.
